info.title: Auren Households API
info.description: Agency platform API. All instants are UTC ISO-8601; dates are YYYY-MM-DD; money is integer minor units with a currency. Errors use the ErrorResponse envelope. Editable records carry a `version`; send it back on update. Repeatable commands accept an Idempotency-Key header.
